text.tspan: Depressive disorders prevalence, IHME vs. WHO 2015
Comparing estimates from IHME's Global Burden of Disease study and WHO's Global Health Observatory on
the share of people with depressive disorders, whether or not they were diagnosed, based on representative
surveys, medical data and statistical modelling.
Share of population with depressive disorders (WHO)
Share of population with depressive disorders (IHME)
